items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: Norwood plays out of town job with me

ctx.x: Oh yes, I don't know him. Norwood Kimball. Who is the bass player now?
Well Norwood Kimball and I have still two, Steele Davis you see. Out of town I mean Norwood plays out of town job with me and Steele Davis plays a job at any time.
We did interview Sidney Brown about two months ago. He did?

items.title: Albert French Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is he any relation to Jeanette Kimball or the other Kimballs? [INTERVIEWEE] I was a husband.

ctx.x: That's right. That's right. Well still Davis is still on Willow and Sonniac. I don't have a corner over here. Willow and Sonniac. I don't have his address. Not far from here. It's still in the downtown front of town side of the bank. It's right over here. Right over the next corner over there. You know what I asked? Yeah. I said Willow. And Upline. I don't have his number. Willow and Upline. I don't have his address.
Is this other bass player, what's his first name? Norwood Kimball. Norwood. Is he any relation to Jeanette Kimball or the other Kimballs?
